solution.p: Standard form is Ax+By=C\text{.} We need to move x- and y-terms to the same side of the equal sign. \begin{aligned} {y}\amp={8x-6}\\ {y}\subtractright{8x}\amp={8x-6}\subtractright{8x}\\ {-8x+y}\amp=-6\\ (-1)({-8x+y})\amp=(-1)(-6)\\ {8x-y}\amp=6 \end{aligned} Note that {-8x+y}=-6 is already in standard form, but its preferable to make the leading coefficient positive.
